title: Practice 10: негде, некуда, некогда — and нигде, никуда, никогда

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Never forget to craft a bed on your first day.
exercises.ru: ___ не забывай скрафтить кровать в свой первый день.
exercises.why: «НЕГДЕ, НЕКУДА, НЕОТКУДА, НЕКОГДА: used with the Infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions. нигде, никуда, ниоткуда, никогда: used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb.» — DLI, Lesson 105. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
